description: This Java class 'ConceptMapTypeEditor' extends PropertyEditorSupport to provide custom conversion between String and ConceptMapType objects within the OpenMRS framework. It handles setting the object from text (by ID or UUID) and retrieving its textual representation.

classes.name: ConceptMapTypeEditor
classes.description: A Java class that customizes property editing support for ConceptMapType objects, enabling conversion from String inputs (ID or UUID) to ConceptMapType instances and vice versa.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a String (ID or UUID) into a ConceptMapType object and sets it as the current value.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Returns the String representation (ID) of the current ConceptMapType object, or an empty string if null.
